name: direwolf over AX.25 on FM
why: The external-decoder path as a person actually walks it: spectrum, a tuner, an FM discriminator, then somebody else's packet decoder on the audio. Everything before the adapter is this tool's own code, so this catches a regression in the tuner, the decimator or the discriminator — and it catches it the way a user would, as a decoder that suddenly says nothing. It also pins the three things about direwolf that were wrong when the adapter was written from documentation: a bare dash is not stdin, it will not start without a config file on a machine with no sound card, and -q hd suppresses the decodes.

expect.note: The audio level travels with each record rather than as a record of its own: 'no decodes' and 'no decodes and the audio was at 4%' are different problems, and only one of them is the decoder's fault.
